title: איסי בר היני

paragraphs: Issi bar Hini ascended from Babylonia in Rav’s time before Rabbi Yochanan. Ulla visited his house, Shabbat 147a, and asked him. Chullin 137b: Rabbi Yochanan told him, “What is the difference between me and you?” See there. Yuchasin needlessly wrote Assi bar Hini.
